title: dryoathyrium erectum
intro: Dryoathyrium erectum, commonly known as the erect dryopteris fern, is a species of fern found in the tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dryoathyrium erectum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
